name: brackets_click
_comment: Wave 9 target brackets on the player's own escorts: Tab never selects them (brackets_tab with w9_esc_a: 30 x No Target), so loops/click_targets.mjs clicks each ship blob in a window shot and shoots the bracket it gets; after the first round `r` twice and Tab once, each with a shot (does r pick an escort?). Pilots w9_esc_a / w9_esc_b (six stock-art escorts each, Kit Range).
